caption: The drawing depicts two small, rectangular wooden sleds with curved runners, oriented side by side and angled slightly toward each other. Each sled contains a figure of a baby bundled in blankets. The sleds are decorated with red, yellow, and green bands or patterns along their edges. The sled on the left has a baby wrapped in tan and brown blankets, with blue securing ties. The baby has black hair and is facing upward. The sled on the right contains a baby bundled in a grayish-white blanket with a green and red decorative pattern, also facing upward, with a visible face and black hair. The image is centered on a plain beige background, enclosed within a double-line rectangular border. The artist's name, "John Fisk," is inscribed in small letters near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Two Cradles with Dolls
